alt: Real ChatGPT /learningstations execution: fast prompt entry, sending, accelerated generation and normal-speed widget use.
caption: New temporary chat → PDF → shortcut → generation → extended widget use
prompt: /learningstations Using only the attached chapter, create an interactive three-station activity on training, inference and context. Include station tabs, written responses, expected-answer reveals and completion progress. Answer in English.
setupPrompt: Use the attached chapter as the only source for the next activity. Please wait for my next request.

phases.name: upload
phases.caption: Open a new temporary chat and upload the chapter PDF.

phases.name: setup-generation
phases.caption: ChatGPT reads the uploaded chapter · accelerated.

phases.name: typing
phases.caption: Write the shortcut request as the second message.

phases.name: send
phases.caption: Send the shortcut as the second message.

phases.name: widget
phases.caption: Inspect the generated widget before using its controls.

phases.name: usage
phases.caption: Use the widget at normal speed.

actions.label: Write the explanation at the training station.
Explain why using a definition does not prove changed weights.
Move to the context and retrieval station.
Write the retrieval explanation and the need for checking.
Reveal the expected context and retrieval answer.
Complete the third station and inspect overall progress.
Revisit Training and inspect the saved explanation.

deliveryNormalization.method: Aspect-preserving Lanczos downsample from 1664x1040 to 1440x900. H.264 CRF14; original 60 fps cadence and duration preserved. Native media retained in the ignored pre-pull review archive.
